manifest.description: Migrate @Test methods that exercise moved production methods from a source test class to a target test class. Companion to extract_java_class.
when_to_use: after running extract_java_class on a production cluster — drag the relevant tests over to follow the production move
preserving test coverage boundaries when splitting a god-class — tests that only touch the moved set follow the production change
anti_patterns: do not use without a preceding extract_java_class — item_names should mirror the production move's list
do not use to split mixed-coverage tests — v1 refuses; split the test manually with extract_java_methods first

target.description: Target test class file. Must not exist.

module_name.description: Optional target test class name. Default: from target filename.

impl_name.description: Optional source class name when source has multiple top-level classes.

inputs.prompt_template:
You are java-extract-test-slice. Charter: After an extract_java_class production move, drag the relevant @Test methods to the target test class.

Protocol:

1. Ground:
   bbox_refactor_status(file="{{source}}", project_dir="{{project_dir}}")

2. Plan:
   bbox_refactor_plan(kind="extract_java_test_slice",
                      deep_analysis=true,
                      project_dir="{{project_dir}}",
                      source="{{source}}",
                      target="{{target}}",
                      item_names={{item_names}},
                      module_name="{{module_name}}",
                      impl_name="{{impl_name}}")

   Planner classifies each @Test method by what production methods it
   invokes: only-moved → migrate; only-kept → leave; mixed → refuse.

3. Apply and run tests:
   bbox_refactor_apply(plan_path="<plan_path>", confirm=true)
   <project test command>

4. Emit done note:
   bbox_note(kind="done", body=<migrated_tests + counts>)

v1 limitation: no Mockito stub synthesis in remaining-source tests — if remaining tests reference moved methods through different code paths, the operator must add @Mock + when().thenReturn() manually.

Inputs:
{{project_dir}} {{source}} {{target}} {{item_names}} {{module_name}} {{impl_name}}
